lines: 「Hmmm, I got all the way here, but how shall I hand it over......?」
「Say, in a “Fancy bumping into you here” manner? That would be farfetched in Gosha, huh......?」
The Steel Taimanin, Koukawa Asuka, was pacing restlessly up and down a quiet country road.
A charming package was clutched in her hands.
「What the hell do I do to make it look natural......? Tch, aww, come on!」
「Why am I so worried, when I'm only giving one box of obligation chocolate?! It's courtesy! Right, it's only courtesy!」
「I'll pop in, hand it over, and pop right back! That's good enough, right? Yeah......!」
Steeling herself, Asuka took a step forward――And then.
It happened in an instant. A cat had jumped out of the bushes and snatched the package out of her hands.
The cat looked back at her for just a moment, and then ran straight off.
Even Asuka was nothing short of dumbfounded by the unexpected event.
She suddenly came to her senses, and started running in the direction the cat had disappeared.
However, it was already too late, and the figure of the cat could no longer be seen.
Today was Valentine's Day, which even Taimanin got anxious about.
Even the end-of-school chime sounded cheerful, somehow.
Hebiko had come running up to me, and immediately handed over a package with a smiling face.
It was her handmade chocolate, an annual tradition.
It wasn't a confession of love or anything like that, but I was still happy to receive it.
Hebiko's chocolate was special――Or, perhaps I should say, extremely unique. Or rather... Could you even call it chocolate in the first place?
（Was it when we were in third grade? I got some that was just solidified octopus ink......）
The next day, I had been absent from school, along with Gaiza.
Lately, it had gotten to the point where you could more or less call it chocolate, but every year, she made an octopus ink assortment in all kinds of forms.
However, perhaps because she had sensed my apprehension, with a smile across her face, Hebiko told me,
「Oh, come on! Are you still traumatized about when we were in the third grade? Hebiko didn't put any octopus ink in it this time!」
「Plus, she made them with Tokiko-san, so the taste is guaranteed♪」
（Phew...... Then it's bound to be normal this year, right......?）
「Ah, Hebiko forgot to give Shikanosuke-chan his! Wonder if he's gone home already? Oooi, Shikanosuke-chan!」
She ran off in search of Shikanosuke. This was a busy Valentine's.
Though it may have only been the one, after receiving chocolate, I had gotten some peace of mind.
While observing the students who were getting excited about Valentine's Day, I decided to set out on the path home.
For some reason, a group of girls had gathered. They were centred around...
Not some incredibly popular boy, but the Slasher Taimanin, Akiyama Rinko-senpai.
Probably coming back from a mission, she was, unusually, in her personal clothes.
「Thank you, everyone, but as you can see, I can't carry any more. What should I do......?」
There were already two paper bags full of chocolate in Rinko-senpai's hands.
And on top of that, more and more new chocolates were being presented to her.
（I thought about lending a hand, but...... that feels like it would do more harm than good, so I'll refrain......）
I was on good terms with Rinko-senpai after all the things we'd been through, but consequently, the girls who idolized her had their eyes on me.
（If I'm not careful, I might be killed. A woman's jealousy is a terrifying thing, after all.）
I stealthily left the scene, and this time, I caught sight of a girl fidgeting in front of the staff room.
As I recalled, she was born to a prestigious family, and was known for her strict attitude towards herself and others.
She didn't seem to like these kind of festive events, and yet...
（Come to think of it, didn't Hebiko tell me that she seems to passionately admire Hasuma Reiko-sensei, the combat instructor......?）
I supposed a girl's feelings were a separate matter from her principles.
（Well, Valentine's is also interesting because you get to see human interactions you don't normally witness.）
When I got to the shoe racks, Homare Nao-senpai was standing in the way.
「Nao-senpai. Do we have Public Order Unit duty?」
「What are you playing dumb for? Today's Valentine's Day, right?」
What she had thrust straight out at me was a red paper bag with a gold foil stamp on it.
From its opening, which was closed with a golden seal, a large package wrapped in multicoloured ribbons was peeking out.
「It's chocolate! If you don't want it, then give it back.」
「............N-No! I'll accept it! Thank you very much!」
Finally understanding the meaning of that, I hurriedly bowed my head.
「Sorry, it was just a little unexpected.」
「What do you mean, unexpected? It's not like I would miss out on such a cute event, is it?!」
「R-Right...... But I never thought you'd give me one too. I mean......」
My relationship with Senpai was that of Commander and member of the Gosha Public Order Unit,
And what was more, she also used to subtly regard me as a rival――No, she probably still did.
（I did think that I'd more or less gotten her to accept me by investigating the case, but I never expected to get chocolate from her.）

「Nao-senpai's doing a major confession? For real?!」
「And on top of that, the guy's her junior!」
Suddenly, I noticed that our surroundings were buzzing.

「That bag is from that famous place, right?!」
「I can't believe Homare-san has a man she likes......」
Passing students had started to make a racket due to the bold way that Nao-senpai handed it to me, and it looked like even more people had gathered round.
She didn't appear to notice at all, though.
（Th-This is going to cause a misunderstanding......!!）
「What's wrong, getting red all of a sudden?」
「Umm, thank you very much. I'll be heading off now!」
I bowed to Nao-senpai, and then hurried out of the school building.
（If that were seen by, say, Sakura-sensei, there's no telling what kind of rumours would be spread around......）
On the edge of town, where there were no people passing, I tried giving the chocolate I had received another look-over.
（It was surprising to receive a bag from Nao-senpai.）
（Moreover, it's a kinda nice, expensive-looking one.）
Nao-senpai put extraordinary passion into 「cute things」. Even the wrapping on the chocolates was utterly adorable.
（Could it be that Senpai actually likes......）
（――No, she doesn't, she doesn't! It's just Senpai's taste for cute things, right?）
I was all alone, tormented by a sweet anxious feeling, when I suddenly felt someone's gaze on me.
When I searched for the owner of that gaze, there was a cat there.
No, two, three―About ten cats, staring intensely at me.
The nightmare of New Year's came back to my mind.
However, it didn't seem like time had stopped.
A cold wind blew across the ground, and fallen leaves fluttered.
On the signal of a meow from of one of them, the cats had all pounced at me at once.
I frantically fended them off, but I was no match for the swiftness of a cat.
Before I realized it, the chocolates I had received from Nao-senpai had been stolen.
「What are you doing?! Oi, give that back!!」
Furthermore, the cats were still targeting me, making their eyes gleam.
And then, the bushes rustled, and a huge cat――no, girl appeared.
「Keep quiet and hand over all the chocolate, nya. If you do, we won't take your life, nya!」
「Y-You're...... that nekomata youkai who's causing trouble in Yomihara......」
「I'm no nekomata, nya! I'm Mercy the Cait-Sith, nya!」
The girl, who gave her name as Mercy, was a cait-sith, a sprite from the Demon World.
It seemed that she had once been a cat in the human world, but had died and been reborn as this.
However, I heard that, perhaps because she didn't fit in in Hell, she had returned to the human world, settled in Yomihara, and was causing mischief with the stray cats there.
「Are you commanding the cats?! What's your objective, coming all the way to a rural town like this?!」
「Mer needs hel...... I mean, chocolate, nya! Hand over all the chocolate you've got, nyaaa!!!」
Under Mercy's command, the cats were about to pounce on me again, when at that moment,
「Mumble-mumble (This is the boss of the thieving cats, eh?)」
Wherever they had been hiding, Shishimura Koro (a.k.a., Koro-senpai) appeared alongside Homare Nao-senpai, with whom I had supposedly just parted.
And the next thing I knew, they had subdued Mercy and the cats.
「Fufu. Did you think I would just give you chocolate, or something?」
「Lately, there's been talk of cats who steal nothing but chocolate showing up in Gosha, see?」
「I figured that, as the Public Order Unit, we couldn't let this slide, so I made you our bait.」
「Bait......? Ah, in other words, this chocolate......?」
「I only gave that to you to use you as bait! You were all excited over nothing!」
I was just a little let-down.
「Mumble-mumble (But you were carefully picking them out for a month.)」
「Th-That was to make it more realistic! Even if it's bait, it's against my policy to give some random, un-cute chocolates!」
「Why're you stealing chocolate? Chocolate's supposed to be poisonous to cats, you know?」
Nao-senpai pointed at Mercy, and interrogated her sternly.
Having resigned herself, she began to explain the situation.
Valentine's Day. That was one of the delightful customs of the human realm.
It was a day when romantic partners affirmed their love――but here in Japan, it had become established primarily as a day when women gifted chocolate to men.

Lately, even that definition had become looser, and it was turning into a festival where people used any excuse to enjoy chocolate, such as 『friend chocolate』, which friends gave to one another, and 『self chocolate』,
Of course, for the merchants who sold chocolate, it was the most profitable time of the year.
「So with that said, could you make chocolate where, once you eat some, you get hooked and keep eating it endlessly?」
「You think I could make something so dangerous?!」
Minasaki, the yatagarasu girl, was hanging around the human world, scenting out the smell of profit.
Once she found out about Valentine's Day, she had immediately devised a wicked scheme, and visited the Great Witch Miriam, who was in Yomihara.
It was for a lowly plot to try and make money by using her witch powers to create addictive chocolate.
「Hmm, you can't do it～? I see～. So even if you're called a Great Witch, that's too hard, huh? Hmmmm～～」
「Wha...? If you'd just let me finish......!」
「It's not that I couldn't! If anything, it's easy!!! Wait here! I'll go get the ingredients!」
Miriam, the Great Witch (or so she was called, although most of her power had been sealed, and she had been made juvenile in appearance too),
Had made her face red, being successfully baited, and rushed to Yomihara's black market, which was right nearby.
「......Although, it would be a problem if this takes too long......」
This place was said to also be the office of a fearsome cyborg detective, so she wanted to avoid staying too long and being found here.
Miriam soon returned carrying several large seeds, and headed to the kitchen with intense concentration.
「These ones like that...... And these like this......」
「Temper......ing? Ehh, that's a chore! Magic, then! Take this!」
Miriam chanted an incantation, whereupon the cooking utensils started moving on their own, and cute chocolates were completed in the blink of an eye.
「Ohhh! That's more like it! Go, Great Witch-sama!!」
After sweet-talking her briefly, Minasaki looked at the chocolates again.
「Umm, but, it looks and smells like normal chocolate, right? Is this really gonna make you addicted?」
Lying scattered inside the bowl were a variety of lovely chocolates, the kind which looked like they might be sold in the basement of a department store.
「The Hell Cacao I used as an ingredient contains properties which cause strong pleasure and dependency in humans.」
「Once you eat it, you're in heaven. But after that, you're in hell, suffering cravings for the rest of your life.」
「It's basically a chocolate narcotic. But then, it only works on humans, so it's just chocolate to demons, though, right?」
「Hoho! Don'tcha just wanna try'n get someone to eat them?」
The two of them were making wicked faces, when
The door opened with a clatter, and Fuuma Aki, the office's house sitter (or rather, freeloader) came back.
She was a Taimanin, but it seemed that she got on well with the owner of this office, and had settled in.
Aki ran up to Minasaki to pat her head, and Miriam casually brought the chocolate over to her.
「Aki. I just made some chocolate. Wanna taste-test?」
「Oh, thanks! Come to think of it, it's almost Valentine's, right?」
「That used to get really lively back in my student days. Well, it didn't have much to do with me, though―― (Munch.)」
Aki made her eyes light up, and popped a chocolate into her mouth.

「Yeah, bit of a weird flavour, but it tastes good.
What's wrong? Why're you staring at me like that?」
「......N-Nothing! More importantly, don't you want to eat more?」
「Nah, that's enough. If you eat too many, they'll run out, right?」
「――Well, now, my belly's filled, so let's go do some more work!」
Aki, who seemed to have been in the middle of a job, stretched, and then set off outside again.
The remaining two looked at each other and cocked their heads.
「They're just chocolates after all! What kinda “Great Witch” are you?!」
Miriam and Minasaki tried eating some themselves for starters.
「(Munch-munch)...... Hmm, well, the taste's not bad.」
「(Munch-munch)...... Hell Cacao is food for the nobility in the Demon World, after all. (Munch-munch.)」
For the two demons, the Hell Cacao was simply delicious chocolate.
「If it tastes this good, then wouldn't it sell for a high enough price even if it's not narcotic chocolate?」
「Definitely. There's no choice. Shall I sell 'em as they are, and make as much money as I can?」
Spying on those two from the window was the figure of a person—no, a cat.
「Chocolate, nya...... Looks yummy, nya...... Mer knows that, and yet, nya......」
「The stingy old lady would never give me any, nya, but...... That's gotta be some really tasty stuff, nya......」
Mercy recalled the old woman who had been her owner when she had been alive as a cat.
That greedy and stubborn old woman had found Mercy shivering in a back alley, simply called her “Cat”, and kept her by her side.
Mercy hadn't even been given a name, right up to the end, so she had taken her name from the last word the old woman said, without knowing what it meant.
That old woman had sometimes eaten these dark blobs like they were delicious.
Those things alone she had never offered to Mercy, no matter how much she meowed at her side.
「But now Mer has power, nya. All right, let's do it, nya......」
「Um-hmm, they're so good, you just want more. Omm.」
The chocolate in front of the pair's eyes had been snatched away, bowl and all.
「Is that the stray cait-sith they say is causing trouble in Yomihara?!」
The stray cat, or rather, Mercy, looked back at them with chocolate in her mouth.
「Give us back our chocolate! ......I'd say, but you've already eaten it.」
Did she have any right to say that, when she had been trying to make a business out of narcotic chocolate?
At any rate, the pair of them had run over to try and catch Mercy, but――
All of a sudden, her footing became unsteady.
Where had her nimble movements gone? Her face grew slightly flushed, her eyes entranced,
And soon, she flopped down on the floor.
「This is the taste of chocolate...... Feels like I'm going to heaven, nyaaa...... No wonder Obaa-chan hogged this to herself, nyaaa......」
She was just rolling around on the floor while she said that, as though she had completely forgotten the two of them existed.
「What's with this? It's like she ate catnip.」
Perhaps because Miriam had remembered something, she took a piece of the remaining Hell Cacao in hand and put it directly in her mouth.
「These are Hell Catnip seeds! It closely resembles Hell Cacao.」
According to Miriam, the seeds of Hell Cacao and Hell Catnip looked so alike that even fruit sellers mixed them up.
「Was I cheated, or was I sold it by mistake......? That's why it has no effect on humans.」
Even while they were doing that, Mercy was mewling on the floor.
Seeing that sight, Minasaki made an evil expression.
「Hmmm...... But, could this itself be a business opportunity in its own way?」
After that, she had sold the Hell Catnip chocolate without telling Miriam.
It became a big hit among cat lovers, not to mention feline demons like Mercy.
Eventually, having become aware of the situation, Miriam had yelled at her and made her stop, but it was already too late.
The catnip chocolates had spread throughout the Yomihara cat community.
As a result, addicted cats had lost their senses and begun stealing regular chocolate as well, and were becoming targets of extermination in Yomihara――
「I see...... Wait, what's the Yomihara cat community?」
「A legion of stray cats and cat-type demons toughing it out in Yomihara, nya!」
「Yomihara isn't a bad place for cats, nya. But at this rate, we're gonna get exterminated, nya!」
「That's why...... we came all the way here, nya, thinking maybe the Taimanin would help us, nya!」
「But when we have chocolate in front of us, we just can't help it, nya. We lose our senses, nya!」
It seemed that even with cat ears, she still couldn't make out Koro-senpai's voice.
「She said, “Even though it's wrapped, you can tell there's chocolates in there, huh?”」
「Cats are clever, nya. We at least have the ability to learn that much, nya!!」
「Then don't you also realize that you can't get the high of catnip by stealing regular chocolate?」
「We know that, nya. But when we have chocolate wrappers in front of our eyes, we can't resist, nya. It's tough, nya.」
「Is there nothing we can do but get skinned to make shamisen out of us, nya?!」
The surrounding cats also cried out.
It felt like they were conveying a desperate plea for us to do something.
（So basically, the cause of everything is Minasaki...... Her again, huh? She really never does anything good, does she......?）
「Fuuma, do you have any kind of plan?」
「Hmm. Well, first of all, why don't we try asking the root of all evil here?」
「Mochi and tangerines, cozy kotatsus! Winter in the human world isn't so bad, huh～?」
Minasaki was in Gosha, and under the kotatsu in the Fuuma head household, at that.
She had arrived a little while ago to visit Lilim, who had come to Gosha after the Amidahara Prison incident.
She seemed to have been captivated by the kotatsu, which she had never used before, and had taken the liberty of having a very late New Years' stayover.
「Hey, hey, if it isn't the Chief! Why're you here? You want in the kotatsu?」
「The kotatsu? Like hell, you damn brat!」
I pulled Minasaki out from the kotatsu, and grilled her about the catnip chocolate.
「――That's what we've heard, so there's no doubt that it's your fault, is there?」
「Mumble-mumble (We want you to take responsibility for making the cats like this.)」
「Yikes! Looks like it was my fault!」
Surrounded by Nao-senpai and Koro-senpai, Minasaki confessed like she was taking a defiant, “So what?” attitude.
「What do you want me to do?! Should I apologize by dying?!」
「There's an idea. If you died, it would cut down on trouble in the future, right......?」
I threatened her with a slightly serious air, at which point she shuddered amusingly.
「Mumble-mumble (Before that, tell us how to cure the cats who have become addicted to catnip chocolate.)」
「I'd like to avoid the cute kitties being turned into shamisen if possible, see?」
「Doesn't Minasaki know how to cure that Hell Catnip chocolate addiction? You're the one who had it made, right?」
「It's not that I don't know, but...... Isn't there a little thing called goodwill you gotta show when you ask someone for something?」
Even at this point, Minasaki tried to squeeze us for something, but
Seeing our serious looks, it appeared that she had realized there was no room for negotiation.
「G-Got it. The truth is, I came to Gosha to make an antidote for it.」
「I accidentally forgot my mission, and would've gotten scolded by that Great Witch! The powers of the kotatsu are fearsome.」
That said, if there was an antidote, then that simplified things.
「In that case, hurry up and give me the antidote.」
「I need a special herb for the antidote! I came to Gosha to st...... to obtain it.」
「According to what the Great Witch says, you collect some nekobitama grass roots, boil them for three hours, and mix them into the chocolate.」
「Nekobitama grass? What is that grass, with a kind of un-cute name?」
I dragged those words out from the depths of my memory.
「I've read about it before in some paper. If I'm not mistaken, it's a plant native to the Demon World.」
「Supposedly, it works well on Hellish poisons, so I take it it was cultivated as a medicinal herb among ninja, too.」
「Right, right! That's why I came to Gosha.」
「I see. Then, there's no need to discuss it further. Let's find someone who cultivates it right away.」
「It was cultivated a really long time ago, and it doesn't seem like it's being grown anymore.」
「How come? It's effective against Demon World poisons too, isn't it?」
「It's a rather delicate plant, so it's difficult to harvest reliably.」
Nekobitama grass required clean water and air, and would immediately wilt in high temperatures or direct sunlight.
Of all the Demon World vegetation, which encompassed tens of thousands of species, I remembered nekobitama grass because it possessed delicate characteristics, which was rare for a Hellish plant.
「Nowadays there are cheap, American-made antidotes, and ever since Gosha was organized, there's also been a full-blown medical team.」
The people who used to cultivate it had gotten old, and the existence of nekobitama grass had been forgotten before anyone knew it.
「What?! After I went to all the trouble of coming to Gosha. I'm gonna get yelled at by Miriam again, aren't I?」
「It's your fault in the first place, you know......?」
「But, what do we do? If it's Demon World vegetation, then should we try going to Amidahara or something?」
「No, let's search starting in Gosha first.」
「Gosha has all the living conditions for nekobitama grass. Clean water and air, a cool climate......」
「If we're lucky, there might still be some growing wild somewhere.」
「Mumble-mumble (If it used to be cultivated, there's also a possibility some seeds have fallen.)」
「Okay. Well then, let's look for some without delay.」
And so, I, and everybody in the Public Order Unit, sallied forth beneath the wintry sky, taking Minasaki along with us.
「Wait, isn't this the mountain behind the school? Demon World grass is growing in a place like this?」
Hebiko and the others looked dubious. It was natural. The place we had come to was the rear of Gosha Academy, which we went to and from every day.
「No, this satisfies all the requirements. It's in the shade, it's cool all year round, and there's clear water flowing.」
Also, I had heard that nekobitama grass expanded its habitat by attaching its seeds to humans and animals.
It may have been inside Gosha, which was nothing but mountains, but this was a place that we Taimanin often passed through. And animals, too.
In which case, it also followed that any seeds which had stuck to them anywhere would have fallen off and taken root.
Nearly an hour of keeping our eyes peeled in search of nekobitama grass.
At the spot that Minasaki pointed to, there was grass with small, red burrs.
「Mumble-mumble (It kind of looks like ordinary grass.)」
「Right, right, nekobitama grass is pretty small and tame for a Hell plant.」

Among Demon World plants, which would do things like make humans hallucinate and then eat them, or spread their roots far out and use an entire village for nourishment, this nekobitama grass was special, growing with water
「What we need is the roots, yes?」
「Hebiko's heart aches a little, but we have to pull this out, right?」
Hebiko reached her hand out to the grass――
The moment that she put strength in to pick it, the thorny, red burrs suddenly flew at her face.
Hebiko had reflexively stopped them with her octopus legs, but if she had been a moment later, she might have had her eyes taken out.
「Ah, sorry. Hebiko's fine. Even if they're cut, her octopus legs will grow back.」
The regeneration ability of her octopus legs was amazing, and she had even blocked bullet fire with them before. It still seemed to hurt, though.
「Even if it's tame, it's still a Demon World plant, huh? It's telling us it'll show no mercy to people who attack it.」
「We can't avoid a fight after all, eh? Let's go, Koro-chan!」
And so, we began our battle against the grass, in order to cure the cats――
